name: Miyanokouji Sachiho
source: Mizuho's deceased mother. Was once Elder Sister back when she was alive. Went to Seio 22 years before Mizuho did and was a close friend of Ichiko. Is described to have looked almost exactly like Mizuho. Died when Mizuho was very young.
